map.粘贴或导入 SRT 字幕内容，按毫秒整体平移时间轴，或按倍率缩放以匹配变速后的视: Paste or import SRT subtitle content, shift the whole timeline by a number of milliseconds, or scale it by a factor to match speed-changed video; it also batch-adjusts subtitle format, so you can fix subtitles that are out of sync with the picture.
map.整体平移：把所有时间码向后 / 向前移动指定毫秒: Shift everything: move all time codes forward or backward by a given number of milliseconds
map.按比例缩放：按倍率拉伸或压缩时间轴以匹配变速视频: Scale proportionally: stretch or compress the timeline by a factor to match speed-changed video
map.支持粘贴 SRT 文本或整段导入: Supports pasting SRT text or importing a whole file
map.逐条时间码实时预览，避免错位: Real-time preview of every time code, avoiding misalignment
map.结果可复制或导出: The result can be copied or exported
map.纯前端处理，字幕不上传: Processed purely in the front end; subtitles are never uploaded
map.视频变速后字幕对不上：按比例缩放时间轴: Subtitles out of sync after speed changes: scale the timeline proportionally
map.字幕整体偏移：统一平移几秒修正: Whole-subtitle offset: shift everything a few seconds
map.多语种字幕对齐：复用同一份时间轴: Multilingual subtitle alignment: reuse one timeline
map.把 SRT 内容粘贴到输入框: Paste the SRT content into the input box
map.选择「平移」并填偏移毫秒，或选「缩放」并填倍率: Choose "Shift" and enter the millisecond offset, or choose "Scale" and enter the factor
map.点击「应用」预览新时间轴: Click "Apply" to preview the new timeline
map.确认无误后复制或导出结果: Copy or export the result once you have confirmed it
map.视频加速到 1.25x，时间轴应除以 1.25（缩放倍率 0.8）: For a video sped up to 1.25x, divide the timeline by 1.25 (scale factor 0.8)
map.平移用毫秒更精细，如偏移 500ms 填 500: Use milliseconds for finer shifts, e.g. enter 500 for a 500 ms offset
map.先小批量试一段确认方向再全量处理: First run a small batch to confirm the direction, then process at full scale
map.缩放会同时改变每条字幕的起止与间隔: Scaling changes the start, end, and gaps of every subtitle at once
map.缩放倍率填多少？: What Scale Factor Should I Enter?
map.目标倍速的倒数。如视频 1.5x，字幕缩放填 1/1.5≈0.667。: The reciprocal of the target playback speed. For a 1.5x video, enter a subtitle scale of 1/1.5 ≈ 0.667.
map.可能是源字幕本身起点偏移，再补一个小的平移量即可。: The source subtitle may simply start too early or late, so adding a small shift fixes it.
